text_block_list.text:
After an eventful year in the Classics,
the first day
of senior year has arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... There's quite a number of people gathered, though I suppose this is to be expected of a shrine at New Year's.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Aren't you cold in that outfit?

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Isn't it obvious just by looking at
me?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Of course I'm cold!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: ...Do you want me to get your coat?
...Do you want to borrow my coat?

text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm fine now... But... maybe I'll need it
later...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Looking at her legs shaking, I worry
about her
catching a cold.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you see the New Year's

announcement?!
text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I saw it. Спешл Уик and Seiun
Sky are
going to run in the spring Tenno
Sho, right?
text_block_list.name: Chaperone

text_block_list.text: No, no! Not that!
text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor

text_block_list.text:
Then, are you talking about what El
Condor
Pasa's doing overseas? Or
maybe about Grass
Wonder?
text_block_list.name: Chaperone

text_block_list.text: No! Not them either! Aghhh...
text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor

text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, it seems like everyone is finally
starting
to notice me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Look over there! It's her! She's been
trending at number
one online!
text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor

text_block_list.text:
You're right! I remember the headline:
"Unforeseen
Detour, Nepo Baby Runs
Wild!" Also, look at what she's
wearing.
Doesn't she know it's winter?
text_block_list.name: Chaperone

text_block_list.text:
I know, right? I should take a picture
with her. I bet you
it'll go viral!
text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor

text_block_list.text:
Well, you know what they say: there's no
such
thing as bad publicity.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
No matter what the story, I must be the
lead. I'll
take whatever steps necessary.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm prepared for whatever anyone has to
say, so
long as I'm the center of their
attention.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Heh. That's what it means to be
first-rate. You
keep your head high, puff
your chest out, and
steal everyone's
hearts.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: So, without further ado...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Everyone!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I am the first-rate Umamusume, King
Halo! And I
look forward to your
continued support this year!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Photos are welcome, but we must be
mindful of
the other visitors! Please take
care not to disturb
them!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That said, I have places I need to be,
but those
hoping to get a photo with me
are welcome to
come along.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Really?! Hmm, I think I just might go!
text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor

text_block_list.text:
H-hey! Well... I guess I'll come get some
pictures
too.
text_block_list.name: Chaperone

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Make sure I look cute, okay?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Phew. Well, that does it for the
impromptu photo
session.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
After a whirlwind of events, Кинг Хало
manages
to take photos with hundreds
of people.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm exhausted. But it was a pretty good strategy, don't you think?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the moment when
the
seeds I just planted blossom at the

Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: ....Achoo!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're so considerate! ♪ A drink
would be
perfect.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... but just one won't do. I'm
parched, and
exhausted to boot.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So, I'm granting you the right to come
along with
me to the vending machine.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You can buy one for yourself as well. I
made you
wait all this time, so you're
probably freezing as
well.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ah! I should get some for everyone back
at the
academy too. We can have a New
Year's tea
party tonight!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Hehe, I guess you remembered.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Give it here, now. Quickly! I'm freezing!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: She rips my coat away from me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! If you want it back, you'll
have to catch
me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I should remind you. The usual New
Year's
party starts at seven!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm granting you the right to make the
necessary
preparations! Ohohoho!
Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
She dashes away at full speed, taking my
stolen
coat along with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Agh!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, delete that photo right this
instant! Hurry
up! I mean it!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
There's no way can I let such a candid
photo
reach the public! If this shot of me
sneezing gets
leaked, my approval
rating will plummet!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
Are sure it won't go up? The photo's kind of
cute.

text_block_list.text:
Of course it won't, you dummy! How
many screws
do you have missing?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I swear, give me that cell phone right
now!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
She takes my phone and immediately
deletes the
photo.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good riddance! You could've said
something if
you wanted a photo. I'll let
you take as many as
you want tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone, smile! Who's the
first-rate
Umamusume?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: King!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Followers

text_block_list.text:
...And so, here I am the next day, filling
the role
of King's personal photographer
at her party.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Trainer! Concentrate on your role
as
photographer!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You must capture the magnificence of
this
first-rate model! Come along, try a
few shots from
this angle!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
After taking a break with some hot tea,
we enjoy
the rest of the New Year's
holiday together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I guess both of us are polishing our skills.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her face turns a flushed red as she runs.
This
might be her fastest sprint yet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
